ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. B — newton (N)

3. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

4. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

6. C — 100 °C

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

9. B — Producers

10. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Safety in handling; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Caring for water environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Re-using water; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Conservation environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
